QuestInfo.2:
During the Cheering Event, you'll receive a beneficial hunting buff every 30 minutes by holding onto the #b#t3994443##k from the Maple Administrator. The Cheerleading Pom-poms will grant buffs of three levels. As the levels go up, the stat bonuses get better.
Your buff will disappear when you log out, but you can always receive a new one (starting from level 1) whenever you want.

Lv. 2: ATT/M. ATT +15, Weapon/Magic DEF +200
Lv. 3: ATT/M. ATT +20, Weapon/M. DEF +200, 
HP/MP +400
